title: bidens bigelovii var. typica
intro: Bidens bigelovii var. typica, commonly known as Bigelow's beggar ticks, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including the relief of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting recovery. The therapeutic actions of Bidens bigelovii var. typica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
